**Finding: COMPLIANT** — no redline proposed.

§ 11.1 (p0096) sets a five-year initial term followed by **automatic one-year renewals**, terminable by **either party on 30 days' written notice** before the end of the initial term or any renewal term.

- **Renewal term length:** 12 months — matches the preferred position; no automatic multi-year renewal (walk-away territory avoided).
- **Non-renewal notice window:** 30 days — at the preferred threshold, well inside the 60-day fallback and far from the 90-day walk-away limit.
- **Direction:** the notice right is mutual, so the exit mechanic runs in our favour.
- **Noted, not flagged:** no vendor obligation to send a 60-day renewal reminder, and no express CPI/3% cap on renewal pricing. Per the playbook these are minor sub-elements; notably, the agreement contains no uplift or escalation language at all (searches for "increase" and the support/maintenance fee provisions in § 5 turned up no price-escalation right), so the vendor is not granted an uncapped increase either. Worth raising in negotiation, but not a deviation.
